crossRefs.note: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone;
And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no…
“Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”
“For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire…

translations.web: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.
translations.bsb: Now the wages of the worker are not credited as a gift, but as an obligation.
translations.kjv: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
translations.asv: Now to him that worketh, the reward is not reckoned as of grace, but as of debt.
